prerequisites: Students from the third educational phase (first semester) and students from the second educational phase (second semester)
A motivation letter indicating what you hope to achieve by participating in this project, due September 27th.
An interview explaining the student's motivation.

learning_outcomes.text: You guide first-year students in independently processing complex learning content through targeted questions and feedback.
You formulate a substantiated reflection on your learning and coaching style based on concrete experiences.
You explain inclusive and sustainable learning strategies using concrete examples.
You provide constructive feedback to peers based on observations and agreements, and apply received feedback to your own actions.

syllabus_topics: Taking on the role of peer tutor for first-year students in theoretically challenging subjects
Guiding students in small groups in their learning process
teaching_methods: Supporting study coach at planning market
Attending one lesson of the course "Sustainable business" on how to deal with ethical issues

assessment_methods.method: Final assignment: written report and presentation justifying the student's guidance approach

assessment_rules: The assessment is a continuous evaluation without an exam during the examination period, resulting in a "Passed / Not Passed" grade. There is no second examination opportunity. No partial transfers are available for this course unit.
